recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中，在正常骨髓系與紅血球系前驅細胞之間，箭頭指向兩個小型淋巴樣細胞，核深染、染色質濃縮，核輪廓有凹陷或裂痕（cleaved/notched），胞質極少，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤的中心細胞（centrocyte）浸潤。
features: Small lymphoid cells (arrow) about the size of a red cell, with very high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Nuclei with condensed chromatin and irregular contours with notches or clefts
No visible nucleoli in the arrowed cells
Background of normal trilineage hematopoiesis: myelocytes, promyelocytes, band neutrophils and erythroblasts
Isolated small lymphoid cells rather than sheets in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with myeloid precursors at various stages and erythroblasts. Interspersed are small lymphoid cells (arrow) with scant cytoplasm, condensed chromatin and irregular, notched or cleaved nuclear contours without nucleoli. Blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by a small cleaved-cell lymphoma, consistent with follicular lymphoma in the appropriate context; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+, CD19+, CD20+, light-chain restriction), trephine biopsy for paratrabecular aggregates and BCL2 rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes and hematogones have smooth round nuclei without clefts, and hematogones show a maturing polytypic phenotype on flow cytometry.
Mantle cells can have slightly irregular nuclei but are CD5+ and cyclin D1+ with t(11;14), rather than CD10+ BCL6+ with t(14;18).
CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like soccer-ball chromatin and are CD5+ CD23+, lacking nuclear clefts.
